### 🍲 Delicious Home Recipe: **Biryani**

**🛒 Key Ingredients:**
• Main base (250g Paneer/Veggies/Rice/Chicken)
• 2 finely chopped onions & 3 pureed tomatoes
• 1 tbsp Ginger-Garlic paste
• 1 tsp Cumin seeds, 1/2 tsp Turmeric, 1 tsp Kashmiri Chilli powder, 1 tsp Garam Masala
• 2 tbsp Fresh cream or butter, Fresh coriander for garnish
• Salt to taste & 2 tbsp cooking oil/ghee

**👩‍🍳 Step-by-Step Instructions:**
1. **Base Gravy:** Heat oil/ghee in a pan. Sauté cumin seeds, onions, and ginger-garlic paste until golden brown.
2. **Spices:** Add tomato puree, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt. Cook until oil separates from the masala (5-7 mins).
3. **Simmer:** Add 1/2 cup warm water, mix well, and simmer on medium heat.
4. **Main Ingredient:** Gently add your sliced paneer/veggies and simmer for 4-5 minutes so the flavours absorb.
5. **Finishing Touch:** Stir in fresh cream and garam masala. Garnish with chopped coriander and serve hot with rotis, naans, or jeera rice!

*Enjoy your family meal!* 🍽️
